title: Project: Cinema Ticket Desk
story: The cinema prices tickets by age and day. Build the desk program.
goal: Read age, then day (mon..sun). Under 5 is free. Ages 5-12 and 60+ pay 80, everyone else 150. On sat or sun add 20, but never to a free ticket. Print the price.
starter:
age = int(input())
day = input()
# work out the price, then print it
hints: First decide the base price with if/elif/else. Then handle the weekend as a separate step.
The weekend surcharge only applies when the price is above 0.
socratic: Which rule decides the base price, and which rule adjusts it?
Why must the free ticket skip the weekend charge?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Cinema Ticket Desk”?
